column2: # Pooled screen. Rosner assumes an approximately normal bulk and wants n >= 25.
# Per thread treatment, where the group is large enough to support it.
message(trt, ": n = ", length(v), ", too small for a Rosner test; skipped.")
res <- tryCatch(rosnerTest(v, k = min(5, length(v) - 2)), error = function(e) NULL)
if (is.null(res)) { message(trt, ": Rosner test failed."); next }
